description: CREATE a new patient record in a location. MUTATES DATA — writes to the connected EHR/PMS. GET the patient back to confirm. POST /patients.

location_id.description: Location id to create the patient in (REQUIRED).

npi.description: Provider NPI, sent as provider.npi in the body.

provider_id.description: Provider id to associate the patient with (REQUIRED).

subdomain.description: Institution subdomain. Defaults to NEXHEALTH_SUBDOMAIN if unset.
